system.description:
A vampire in torpor is helpless — but a Methuselah with False Slumber is the exception, his body lying dormant while his spirit moves about freely in astral form.

Once learned, False Slumber activates the instant you enter torpor; astral travel then follows the rules for Psychic Projection, though waking your physical body is resolved normally. Should your silver cord be severed in astral combat, you are lost in the spirit realms as usual and additionally lose this power and half your permanent Willpower Traits (round up), which must be bought back with experience. Your soul then spends a year and a night returning to your body, during which you cannot be roused from torpor by any means.
